channel.title: AIBuilder Marketplace — new honest reviews
channel.description: Hand-researched, honest software reviews: real pricing, the honest knock, who should skip it. No hype, no invented numbers.

item.title: Pabbly Connect Review (2026): Zapier Alternative, Tested
item.description: Pabbly Connect, Free: 100 tasks a month, no card asked. In our test the email step could not be used without our own SMTP server details.

item.title: BestTrack Review (2026): Order Tracking App, Tested
item.description: BestTrack, Free: 300 tracked orders a month, branded order tracking page, email notifications and custom templates, dropshipping mode.

item.title: Loox Review (2026): Photo Reviews App, Tested
item.description: Loox, Beginner: free, up to 500 orders. The free plan keeps the Loox branding and leaves out video reviews and the AI features.

item.title: Sledge Review (2026): Search and Filters, Tested
item.description: Sledge, Pro: $29.99 a month, 10,000 products indexed, 14 day free trial. We tested only the free development store setup.

item.title: ShipProtect Review (2026): Shipping Protection, Tested
item.description: ShipProtect ShippingProtection: A free plan for developer partner stores is also listed. The app does not handle claims.

item.title: Wiz Email App Review (2026): AI Email Flows, Tested
item.description: Wiz Email App, Free plan: up to 500 active contacts. The listing says the Pro and AI Agency prices rise as active contacts grow and does not give the steps.

item.title: GemPages Review (2026): Shopify Page Builder, Tested
item.description: GemPages, Free plan: 1 published page (limit seen in our test). The pricing page also mentions paying commission as you grow.

item.title: MailerLite Review (2026): Email Marketing, Tested
item.description: MailerLite, Free: up to 250 subscribers and 2,500 emails, 0 a month. The free plan stops at 250 subscribers, and prices rise with the subscriber count.

item.title: Stock Photo Site Review (2026): Free AI Images, Tested
item.description: This stock photo site's AI plan is EUR 9 a month billed yearly (EUR 19 with no contract) for 100 credits; two free generations, tested. Who it suits.

item.title: Vibe Review (2026): Streaming TV Ads, Tested
item.description: Vibe, Banner on 22 November 2026: spend $5,000 on streaming TV ads, get $5,000 in bonus ad credits. Vibe sells ad spend, so cost depends on delivery.

item.title: Cal.com Review (2026): Free Plan, Tested
item.description: Cal.com, Individuals: free forever. Team features such as round-robin, collective events, routing forms and removing the Cal.com branding need a paid plan.

item.title: OPTIS Product Options Review (2026): Free Plan, Tested
item.description: OPTIS Product Options, Free plan: 10 variant option sets, 10+ product option types, analytics, email and live support, watermark removed.

item.title: BSS B2B Lock Review (2026): Hide Prices
item.description: BSS B2B Lock, Free plan: lock the entire website by condition, free setup help from BSS support. Hiding prices needs a paid plan.

item.title: BSS B2B Solution Review (2026): Wholesale Pricing
item.description: BSS B2B Solution: Essential is $29 a month or $313.20 a year. The free plan covers only 1 custom pricing rule and 1 registration form on live stores.

item.title: Cartly Review (2026): Cart Drawer, Free to 20 Orders
item.description: Cartly: Free for the first 20 lifetime orders. The price follows your orders: $16.99 a month up to 100 orders, $49.99 for 301 to 750 and $199.99 above…

item.title: Nifty Review (2026): Free Plan Limit Is Easy to Miss
item.description: Nifty: Free is $0 forever with unlimited members, 2 active projects, 500 tasks and 100 MB of files. The free limit is easy to miss.

item.title: Tally Review (2026): Free Forms With a Badge, Tested
item.description: Tally: The free plan lists unlimited forms and submissions as long as you stay within the fair usage guidelines.

item.title: TrueMargin Review (2026): Shopify Profit Per Order, Free
item.description: TrueMargin by Fleeta Limited is listed as Free on the Shopify App Store, with the text "free right now". The overview screen shows no margin percentage.

item.title: KudosCRM Review (2026): Free CRM, Paid From $9 a Seat
item.description: KudosCRM: Basic costs $9 per seat a month billed yearly or $12 monthly. The Free plan allows 1 pipeline and 3 seats.

item.title: DocHub Review (2026): Free Plan Has 3 Uses, Tested Nov 2026
item.description: DocHub: Basic is €8 a month billed yearly or €11 billed monthly. The free plan's 3 uses a month are shared by editing, self-signing and sign requests.

item.title: ShopRaise Workplace Giving Review (2026): Pricing Notes
item.description: ShopRaise Workplace Giving: ShopRaise sells a single package called All-In at $2 per employee per month. We could not read ShopRaise's own pricing page.

item.title: HOL Guard Review (Tested 2026): Agent Security, Free to $30
item.description: HOL Guard, Free: $0 forever, local protection, no account or card. Coverage is specific to each supported tool and event.

item.title: Make Review (Tested 2026): Visual Automation, Free to $15
item.description: Make, Free: $0, 1,000 credits a month, 15-minute minimum interval. Billing is by credits and the price moves with the slider.

item.title: Langwill Review (2026): Shopify Translation, Free to $49.99
item.description: Langwill, Free: 5,000 words, 1 translated language, 153 currencies, multilingual SEO. Auto-translate and image translation need Growth.

item.title: Social Snowball Review (2026): Shopify Affiliates, From $249
item.description: Social Snowball, Snow Day: $249 a month plus 3% of affiliate revenue. One merchant review from 10 November 2026 says the affiliate side is English only.

item.title: PageFly Review (Tested): Free Plan, Paid From $24 a Month
item.description: PageFly: $0, 1 published page or section, 10 AI credits a month, 320+ templates, demo dashboard, no card. The price depends on how many pages you publish.

item.title: Easy-Peasy.AI Review (2026): Free Plan, Paid From $8 a Month
item.description: Easy-Peasy.AI, Free: $0, 1,000 words, 1 image credit, 1 transcription, 1,000 text-to-speech characters, 1 bot, 170+ templates, public images, no card.

item.title: Seobility Review (2026): Free Account, Premium 59.90 EUR a Month
item.description: Seobility, Basic: free, no time limit, 1 project, 10 keywords, 100 pages per crawl, limited website audit, 5 daily tool credits, 3 tracked AI prompts.

item.title: EmailOctopus Review (2026): Free to 2,500 Subscribers, Pro $9
item.description: EmailOctopus: $20 a month, or $18 a month billed yearly ($216 a year), for 1,001 to 2,500 subscribers and 25,000 emails. The price grows with your list.

item.title: Rewardful Review (2026): Affiliate Tracking for Stripe, From $49
item.description: Rewardful: Enterprise from $149 a month or $1,490 a year (up to $30,000 on the entry tier). Starter gives only 1 campaign and no branded portal.
